# Omarchy theme fixtures

`<theme>/colors.toml` is copied unchanged from the 22 themes bundled with Omarchy 4.0.4
(`/usr/share/omarchy/themes/`), read from a real Omarchy install. The tests use them to prove that
every Omarchy theme becomes a Polycarp theme that passes the contrast rules.

Omarchy is MIT licensed (https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy). The copy of Omarchy these files came
from ships no `LICENSE` file under `/usr/share/omarchy`, so no copyright holder could be read from
the machine; the package metadata there says only `Licenses: MIT`. The upstream license file names
the holder. These files are test data only and are not built into the `polycarp` program.
